positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• As a full-stack developer, contributed significantly on launches of multiple web applications, such as mohawkflooring.com and aladdincommercial.com, built on ASP .NET MVC (C#) and Sitecore CMS
• Implemented and optimized both front-end and back-end of the enhanced Product Details Page using AngularJS, HTML5, and Sass
• Designed and implemented the product comparison tool which is now used in multiple Mohawk Industry websites
• Reduced time to load the project resourcing page by 80% by redesigning APIs and introducing new JS framework, AngularJS, to internal time tracking tool

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Led a recitation class using lecture notes and customized coding examples in the Data Structures and Algorithms course
• Held weekly office hours to assist individual students and provide oversight on assignments

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and deployed new features of the dynamic .NET web application (C#) as a full-stack developer
• Increased the search engine rankings by creating new templates for search engine optimization
• Optimized the loading time by reducing the number of HTTP requests by 50%
• Improved the QA process by creating automated testing process with Selenium
